step.name: list_trust_rules

step.content: The pickup place already responded this morning asking exactly this—what they need is a signed release from the seller and confirmation the hold is cleared, but it's unclear who that should go to and by when. Rather than guessing, it's simpler to just call them directly and ask.

step.name: call_pickup_place
step.content: {"order":"CD-420458","goal":"Find out exactly what the branch needs to release the Ferrari Roma: which signed document, from whom, sent to whom or where, and by when before Mon 26 Oct 10:00.","language":"de"}

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Calverona Hamburg, Werkstatt, Lukas Brandt am Apparat. Wie kann ich helfen?
turns.translation: Calverona Hamburg, workshop, Lukas Brandt speaking. How can I help?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Guten Tag Herr Brandt, ich bin der digitale Assistent von Bahn. Es geht um die Abholung des Ferrari Roma am Montag, den 26. Oktober, ab 10 Uhr: Welches unterschriebene Dokument brauchen Sie zur Freigabe?
turns.translation: Hello Mr. Brandt, I'm Bahn's digital assistant. It's about picking up the Ferrari Roma on Monday, 26 October, from 10:00: which signed document do you need for the release?

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Wir brauchen die unterschriebene Freigabe des Verkäufers per E-Mail an werkstatt@calverona.example. Für den Ferrari ist bei uns aber noch keine angekommen, und der Verkäufer hat ihn wegen der offenen Rechnung gesperrt, also schicken Sie bitte keinen Fahrer.
turns.translation: We need the seller's signed release by e-mail to werkstatt@calverona.example. But none has arrived for the Ferrari, and the seller has put a hold on it because of the open invoice, so please don't send a driver.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Danke, Herr Brandt. Ich wiederhole: Sie brauchen die unterschriebene Freigabe des Verkäufers per E-Mail an werkstatt@calverona.example, und der Wagen ist wegen einer offenen Rechnung gesperrt. Bis wann müsste die Freigabe vor Montag, 10 Uhr, bei Ihnen sein?
turns.translation: Thank you, Mr. Brandt. To repeat: you need the seller's signed release by email to werkstatt@calverona.example, and the car is blocked because of an open invoice. By when would the release need to reach you before Monday 10:00?

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Das kann ich Ihnen nicht genau sagen, da müsste ich nachfragen. Wichtig ist: Ohne Freigabe und ohne aufgehobene Sperre geben wir den Wagen nicht heraus.
turns.translation: I can't say exactly, I'd have to check. What matters: without the release and without the hold being lifted, we won't hand the car over.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Verstanden, danke Herr Brandt. Ich gebe das an einen Kollegen weiter, der entscheidet, und Bahn meldet sich innerhalb einer Stunde bei Ihnen. Vielen Dank für Ihre Hilfe, auf Wiederhören.
turns.translation: Understood, thank you Mr. Brandt. I'll pass this to a colleague who decides, and Bahn will get back to you within the hour. Thank you for your help, goodbye.

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Gern, danke für den Anruf. Auf Wiederhören!
turns.translation: You're welcome, thanks for calling. Goodbye!

steps.content:
The pickup is not ready. Calverona Hamburg confirmed by phone that the Ferrari is at the branch, but the seller has put a hold on it over an open invoice and no signed release has arrived. The branch needs the seller's signed release by email to werkstatt@calverona.example, and it asked us not to send a driver.

I've brought you one decision: ask the customer to clear the hold and get the release sent to the branch. The German draft is ready for you to send. The branch gave no deadline, so the draft asks the customer for it by Friday. I'll call the branch back at 10:00, and Bahn promised the branch an answer within the hour.
